about: Modwerk source-only control-in-actions package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/control-in-actions.

mods.title: Control In Actions
mods.summary: A footswitch or gate on EXP/CV IN 1 or 2 holds or toggles MUTE or live recording, or holds or latches FILL.
mods.description: Stock's CONTROL INPUT menus get an ACTION mode: a footswitch or a 0 to 5 V gate on EXP/CV IN 1 or 2 holds or toggles the MUTE screen or live recording, or holds or latches FILL. Bars beside the menu show the input and when it counts as pressed, ACTION LEARN reads a footswitch's levels, and NO in either learn keeps the saved levels.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author, builds alone: CI06 and CI07 (this module's source before the ACTION LEARN name and the code review's fixes) passed every action, ACTION LEARN with YES and NO, REVERSE DIRECTION, EXPRESSION LEARN's NO and a power cycle. CI09 (this package's source, built locally) then passed the bars, ACTION LEARN's and EXPRESSION LEARN's NO and a hold action. Not run beside other modules.
